preference_text:
--- Refinement ---
This is a design revision of the existing mock. Goal: Add a new ReAct Loop example app to BWS4 demonstrating the interleaved reason-act-observe shape of the planning-agent tier, in deliberate contrast with the existing plan-first Planning Agent example, and cross-reference the two apps from the Planning Agent overview. Update the mock to reflect this revision's added features (ReAct_Loop_Example_App); changed features (Planning_Agent_Example_App). Preserve the existing look and feel — colour scheme, typography, spacing, layout, and every screen or element these changes do not touch. Change only what these feature updates require.  Place the card for the new ReAct Loop example at the end of the list.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="dark">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Built with Spec4 (BWS4)</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg: #0a0a0f;
    --bg-alt: #101018;
    --surface: #14141e;
    --surface-2: #191927;
    --border: #26263a;
    --text: #eef0fa;
    --text-dim: #9b9cb5;
    --text-faint: #6a6b85;
    --accent1: #7c5cff;
    --accent2: #4ea1ff;
    --accent-grad: linear-gradient(120deg, #7c5cff, #4ea1ff);
    --success: #34d399;
    --warn: #f6b93b;
    --danger: #ff6b6b;
    --radius: 14px;
    --shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(124,92,255,0.12);
    --mono: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace;
    --font: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
  }
  html[data-theme="light"]{
    --bg: #f7f7fb;
    --bg-alt: #ffffff;
    --surface: #ffffff;
    --surface-2: #f1f1fa;
    --border: #e2e2ee;
    --text: #191926;
    --text-dim: #55566b;
    --text-faint: #8a8ba0;
    --shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(124,92,255,0.10);
  }
  *{ box-sizing: border-box; }
  html,body{ height:100%; }
  body{
    margin:0;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    font-family: var(--font);
    line-height:1.5;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    transition: background .25s ease, color .25s ease;
  }
  a{ color: inherit; text-decoration:none; }
  ::selection{ background: rgba(124,92,255,.35); }

  /* ===== Top nav ===== */
  .topnav{
    position: sticky; top:0; z-index: 50;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
    padding: 14px 28px;
    background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 85%, transparent);
    backdrop-filter: blur(14px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .brand{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
  .brand-mark{
    font-weight:800; font-size:18px; letter-spacing:.3px;
    background: var(--accent-grad);
    -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
  }
  .brand-sub{ font-size:11px; color: var(--text-faint); font-family: var(--mono); }
  .nav-right{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; }
  .theme-btn{
    width:36px; height:36px; border-radius: 10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:16px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .theme-btn:hover{ border-color: var(--accent2); }

  /* ===== Hamburger menu ===== */
  .menu-wrap{ position:relative; }
  .menu-btn{
    width:36px; height:36px; border-radius: 10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--surface); color: var(--text); cursor:pointer; font-size:17px;
    display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  }
  .menu-btn:hover{ border-color: var(--accent2); }
  .menu-dropdown{
    position:absolute; top: calc(100% + 10px); right:0;
    display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:2px;
    min-width:240px; background: var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px; padding:8px; box-shadow: var(--shadow); z-index:60;
  }
  .menu-dropdown.open{ display:flex; }
  .menu-dropdown button{
    background:none; border:none; color: var(--text-dim);
    font-size:14px; padding:10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; cursor:pointer;
    text-align:left; font-family: var(--font); transition: all .15s ease;
  }
  .menu-dropdown button:hover{ color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-2); }
  .menu-dropdown button.active{ color: var(--text); background: var(--surface-2); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--border); }

  /* ===== Screens ===== */
  .screen{ display:none; max-width: 1180px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 40px 28px 90px; animation: fadeIn .35s ease; }
  .screen.active{ display:block; }
  @keyframes fadeIn{ from{opacity:0; transform: translateY(6px);} to{opacity:1; transform:none;} }

  .tag{
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.5px; text-transform:uppercase;
    padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border:1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-dim);
    background: var(--surface-2);
  }
  .tag.dot::before{ content:''; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background: var(--accent2); }

  /* ===== Landing ===== */
  .hero{ padding: 60px 0 40px; text-align:center; }
  .hero h1{
    font-size: 44px; margin: 18px 0 14px; letter-spacing:-1px;
    background: var(--accent-grad); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
  }
  .hero p{ max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; color: var(--text-dim); font-size:16px; }
  .hero-badges{ display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center; margin-top:22px; flex-wrap:wrap; }

  .section-heading{ display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; margin: 46px 0 18px; }
  .section-heading h2{ font-size:20px; margin:0; }
  .section-heading span{ color: var(--text-faint); font-size:13px; font-family: var(--mono); }

  .app-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(260px,1fr)); gap:18px; }
  .app-card{
    background: var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 22px; cursor:pointer; transition: all .2s ease; position:relative; overflow:hidden;
  }
  .app-card::before{
    content:''; position:absolute; inset:0; background: var(--accent-grad); opacity:0;
    transition: opacity .2s ease;
  }
  .app-card:hover{ transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow); border-color: var(--accent1); }
  .app-card.disabled{ opacity:.55; cursor:not-allowed; }
  .app-card.disabled:hover{ transform:none; box-shadow:none; border-color: var(--border); }
  .app-card h3{ margin: 10px 0 8px; font-size:17px; }
  .app-card p{ color: var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin: 0 0 16px; }
  .app-card .go{ font-size:13px; font-weight:600; color: var(--accent2); }
  .app-card .go::after{ content:' →'; }

  .footnote{
    margin-top: 60px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--text-faint); font-size:12.5px; text-align:center; font-family: var(--mono);
  }

  /* ===== Screen headers (RAG/Tool/Console/Embeddings) ===== */
  .screen-head{ margin-bottom: 30px; }
  .screen-head h1{ font-size:28px; margin: 8px 0 8px; }
  .screen-head p{ color: var(--text-dim); font-size:14.5px; max-width: 720px; }
  .screen-head .tags{ display:flex; gap:8px; margin-bottom: 6px; flex-wrap:wrap; }

  .layout-2col{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr; gap:22px; align-items:start; }
  @media (max-width: 900px){ .layout-2col{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

  .card{
    background: var(--surface); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 20px;
  }
  .card h4{ margin:0 0 12px; font-size:14px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px; color: var(--text-dim); }

  /* ===== Dataset browser ===== */
  .doc-item{ border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:10px; overflow:hidden; }
  .doc-head{
    display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:12px 14px;
    cursor:pointer; background: var(--surface-2);
  }
  .doc-head strong{ font-size:13.5px; }
  .doc-head span{ font-size:11px; color: var(--text-faint); font-family: var(--mono); }
  .doc-body{ max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition: max-height .25s ease; }
  .doc-body p{ padding: 12px 14px; margin:0; font-size:13px; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .doc-item.open .doc-body{ max-height: 240px; }
  .doc-item.open .chevron{ transform: rotate(90deg); }
  .chevron{ transition: transform .2s ease; color: var(--text-faint); }

  /* ===== RAG form / chips ===== */
  .chip-row{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; margin: 10px 0 16px; }
  .chip{
    font-size:12.5px; padding:7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; border:1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text-dim); cursor:pointer; transition:.15s;
  }
  .chip:hover{ border-color: var(--accent1); color: var(--text); }
  .chip.active{ border-color: var(--accent1); color: var(--text); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent1); }

  .qform{ display:flex; gap:10px; }
  .qform input[type=text]{
    flex:1; padding:13px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--bg-alt); color: var(--text); font-size:14.5px;
  }
  .qform input[type=text]:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--accent1); }
  .text-input{
    width:100%; padding:13px 16px; border-radius: 10px; border:1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--bg-alt); color: var(--text); font-size:14.5px; font-family: var(--font);
  }
  .text-input:focus{ outline:none; border-color: var(--accent1); }
  .btn{
    padding: 12px 20px; border-radius:10px; border:none; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; font-size:14px;
    background: var(--accent-grad); color:#fff; transition: transform .15s ease, opacity .15s;
    white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .btn:hover{ transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .btn:disabled{ opacity:.6; cursor:not-allowed; transform:none; }
  .btn.secondary{ background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--text); border:1px solid var(--border); }
  .btn.small{ padding: 8px 14px; font-size:12.5px; }

  .result-panel{ margin-top: 22px; }
  .stage-line{ display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; margin-bottom: 14px; font-size:13px; color: var(--text-faint); font-family: var(--mono); }
  .spinner{
    width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%; border:2px solid var(--border); border-top-color: var(--accent2);
    animation: spin .7s linear infinite;
  }
  @keyframes spin{ to{ transform: rotate(360deg); } }

  .answer-card{
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius);
    padding: 22px; box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  }
  .answer-card.warn{ border-color: var(--warn); box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(246,185,59,.12); }
  .answer-card.err{ border-color: var(--danger); box-shadow: 0 10px 40px rgba(255,107,107,.12); }
  .answer-meta{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; margin-bottom: 14px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .confidence{
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; padding:4px 10px; border-radius:999px;
  }
  .confidence.high{ background: rgba(52,211,153,.14); color: var(--success); border:1px solid rgba(52,211,153,.3); }
  .confidence.low{ background: rgba(246,185,59,.14); color: var(--warn); border:1px solid rgba(246,185,59,.3); }
  .answer-text{ font-size:15.5px; margin: 6px 0 20px; }
  .answer-text .cite{
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; color: var(--accent2); cursor:default; vertical-align: super;
  }
  .warning-banner{
    display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:flex-start; background: rgba(246,185,59,.1); border:1px solid rgba(246,185,59,.35);
    padding: 12px 14px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:18px; font-size:13px; color: var(--warn);
  }
  .passages-block h5{ font-size:12.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px; color: var(--text-dim); margin: 0 0 10px; }
  .passage{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding: 12px 14px; margin-bottom: 10px; background: var(--surface-2);
  }
  .passage-top{ display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:6px; gap:10px; }
  .passage-top strong{ font-size:13px; }
  .score-badge{ font-family: var(--mono); font-size:11px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:6px; background: var(--bg); border:1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-faint); }
  .passage p{ margin:0; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--text-dim); }

  /* ===== Tool use screen ===== */
  .steps{ display:flex; gap:14px; margin: 18px 0 22px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .step{
    flex:1; min-width:170px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding: 14px;
    background: var(--surface); font-size:13px; color: var(--text-faint); position:relative;
  }
  .step .num{ font-family: var(--mono); font-size:11px; color: var(--text-faint); }
  .step .label{ display:block; margin-top:6px; color: var(--text-dim); font-weight:600; }
  .step.active{ border-color: var(--accent1); color: var(--text); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent1) inset; }
  .step.active .label{ color: var(--text); }
  .step.done{ border-color: var(--success); }
  .step.done .label{ color: var(--success); }

  .routing-line{
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:12px; color: var(--accent2); margin-bottom: 14px;
    display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center;
  }
  .result-list{ display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; margin-top: 8px; }
  .result-item{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:14px; background: var(--surface-2);
    display:flex; gap:14px; align-items:flex-start;
  }
  .rank-badge{
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:12px; color:#fff; background: var(--accent-grad);
    width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .result-item h5{ margin:0 0 4px; font-size:14px; }
  .result-item p{ margin:0 0 6px; font-size:13px; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .source-label{ font-family: var(--mono); font-size:11px; color: var(--text-faint); }

  /* ===== Embeddings screen ===== */
  .embed-plot-wrap{ position:relative; width:100%; }
  .embed-plot-wrap svg{
    width:100%; height:auto; display:block; background: var(--bg-alt);
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 10px;
  }
  .embed-point-label{ font-size:9px; fill: var(--text-faint); font-family: var(--mono); pointer-events:none; }
  .embed-legend{ display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-top:14px; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .embed-legend .legend-item{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; }
  .legend-dot{ width:10px; height:10px; border-radius:50%; display:inline-block; }
  .legend-dot.custom{ border-radius:2px; transform: rotate(45deg); }

  /* ===== Single-call screen ===== */
  .mode-toggle{ display:flex; gap:8px; margin: 10px 0 16px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
  .mode-btn{
    padding:9px 16px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--border); background: var(--surface-2);
    color: var(--text-dim); cursor:pointer; font-size:13px; font-family: var(--font); transition: all .15s ease;
  }
  .mode-btn:hover{ color: var(--text); border-color: var(--accent1); }
  .mode-btn.active{ color:#fff; background: var(--accent-grad); border-color: transparent; }
  .structured-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:14px; margin-top: 14px; }
  @media (max-width: 700px){ .structured-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .structured-block h6{ margin:0 0 8px; font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px; color: var(--text-faint); font-family: var(--mono); }
  .structured-block pre{
    margin:0; background: var(--bg-alt); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:14px;
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:12px; color: var(--text-dim); white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word;
    max-height:280px; overflow:auto;
  }
  .field-hint{ font-size:12.5px; color: var(--danger); margin-top:8px; }

  /* ===== Orchestrated subagents screen ===== */
  .roster-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px,1fr)); gap:12px; }
  .roster-item{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 14px; background: var(--surface-2);
    transition: border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;
  }
  .roster-item .rname{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:13.5px; font-weight:600; }
  .roster-item .rscope{ margin:6px 0 0; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .roster-item.chosen{ border-color: var(--accent1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent1) inset; }
  .roster-item.chosen .chosen-flag{
    display:inline-block; margin-left:auto; font-family: var(--mono); font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.4px; color: var(--accent2);
  }
  .roster-item .chosen-flag{ display:none; }
  .spec-dot{ width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%; display:inline-block; flex-shrink:0; }

  .subagent-cols{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:14px; margin-top: 6px; }
  @media (max-width: 820px){ .subagent-cols{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .subagent-col{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background: var(--surface-2); padding:14px;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;
  }
  .subagent-col.running{ border-color: var(--accent1); }
  .subagent-col.done{ border-color: var(--success); }
  .subagent-col.failed{ border-color: var(--danger); }
  .subagent-head{ display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px; }
  .subagent-head strong{ font-size:13.5px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; }
  .sa-status{
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:10.5px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.4px;
    padding:3px 8px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-faint); background: var(--bg);
    display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .sa-status.running{ color: var(--accent2); border-color: rgba(78,161,255,.4); }
  .sa-status.done{ color: var(--success); border-color: rgba(52,211,153,.35); }
  .sa-status.failed{ color: var(--danger); border-color: rgba(255,107,107,.4); }
  .brief-box{
    border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:10px 12px; background: var(--bg-alt);
    font-size:12.5px; color: var(--text-dim);
  }
  .brief-box .brief-label{
    display:block; font-family: var(--mono); font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px;
    color: var(--text-faint); margin-bottom:5px;
  }
  .sa-answer{ font-size:13.5px; color: var(--text); margin:0; min-height:20px; }
  .sa-answer .caret{
    display:inline-block; width:7px; height:14px; background: var(--accent2); vertical-align:-2px;
    margin-left:2px; animation: blinkCaret .8s steps(1) infinite;
  }
  @keyframes blinkCaret{ 50%{ opacity:0; } }
  .runs-tag{ margin-left:auto; }
  .merge-note{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background: var(--surface-2); padding:12px 14px; margin-top:14px;
  }
  .merge-note h6{
    margin:0 0 8px; font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px; color: var(--text-faint); font-family: var(--mono);
  }
  .merge-note ul{ margin:0; padding-left:18px; }
  .merge-note li{ font-size:12.5px; color: var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:4px; }
  .merge-note li:last-child{ margin-bottom:0; }

  /* ===== Multi-agent collaboration screen ===== */
  .agent-card-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px,1fr)); gap:12px; }
  .agent-card{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background: var(--surface-2); overflow:hidden;
  }
  .agent-card-head{
    display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:12px 14px; cursor:pointer;
  }
  .agent-card-head strong{ font-size:13.5px; }
  .agent-card-head .chevron{ margin-left:auto; font-size:11px; }
  .agent-card-body{ max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition: max-height .25s ease; }
  .agent-card.open .agent-card-body{ max-height: 320px; }
  .agent-card.open .chevron{ transform: rotate(90deg); }
  .agent-card-body dl{ margin:0; padding: 0 14px 14px; }
  .agent-card-body dt{
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.5px;
    color: var(--text-faint); margin-top:8px;
  }
  .agent-card-body dd{ margin:2px 0 0; font-size:12.5px; color: var(--text-dim); }
  .agent-role-pill{
    font-family: var(--mono); font-size:10px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.4px;
    padding:2px 7px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--border); color: var(--text-faint); background: var(--bg);
  }

  .negotiation-grid{ display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap:14px; margin-top:6px; }
  @media (max-width: 820px){ .negotiation-grid{ grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .seller-track{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; background: var(--surface-2); padding:14px;
    display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px;
  }
  .seller-track.running{ border-color: var(--accent1); }
  .seller-track.done{ border-color: var(--success); }
  .seller-track.failed{ border-color: var(--danger); }
  .buyer-track{
    border:1px solid var(--border); border-left:3px solid var(--accent2); border-radius:10px;

<main>

  <!-- ================= LANDING SCREEN ================= -->
  <section class="screen active" id="screen-landing">

      <h1>Built with Spec4 (BWS4)</h1>
      <p>BWS4 is a framework and a growing collection of example apps that demonstrate what Spec4 can build. Every example below — including this landing page — was built <em>using</em> Spec4, so you're looking at a live demonstration, not a slide deck.</p>
      <div class="hero-badges">

      <span>derived from the current set of available example apps</span>
    </div>

      <!-- populated by JS -->
    </div>

    <div class="footnote">Every app in this directory shares the same shared services, navigation, and visual language — consistent by design.</div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= RAG SCREEN ================= -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-rag">
    <div class="screen-head">
      <div class="tags">
        <span class="tag dot">Pattern: Retrieval-Augmented Generation</span>
        <span class="tag">Reference dataset: Space Exploration Facts</span>
      </div>
      <h1>RAG Example App</h1>
      <p>Ask a question and watch BWS4 retrieve supporting passages from a small public dataset, then generate an answer grounded in what it found. Both the retrieved passages and the generated answer are shown, so the retrieval → generation chain stays visible.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="layout-2col">
      <div class="card" id="datasetCard">
        <h4>Reference Dataset (5 documents)</h4>
        <div id="docList"></div>
      </div>

      <div>
        <div class="card">
          <h4>Ask a question</h4>
          <div class="chip-row" id="ragChips"></div>
          <form class="qform" id="ragForm">
            <input type="text" id="ragInput" placeholder="e.g. When did Voyager 1 launch and what is it doing now?" />
            <button class="btn" type="submit" id="ragSubmit">Ask</button>
          </form>
        </div>

        <div class="result-panel" id="ragResultPanel"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= TOOL USE SCREEN ================= -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-tooluse">
    <div class="screen-head">
      <div class="tags">
        <span class="tag dot">Pattern: Tool Use / Function Calling</span>
        <span class="tag">Capability: Live search tool</span>
      </div>
      <h1>Tool-Use Example App</h1>
      <p>Submit a query that needs current information. The agent decides it needs outside data, calls a search tool, then synthesizes an answer from the returned results — illustrating how an agent incorporates external information mid-response.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <h4>Ask something that needs a live lookup</h4>
      <div class="chip-row" id="toolChips"></div>
      <form class="qform" id="toolForm">
        <input type="text" id="toolInput" placeholder="e.g. What's the latest Spec4 release?" />
        <button class="btn" type="submit" id="toolSubmit">Run agent</button>
      </form>
    </div>

    <div class="result-panel" id="toolResultPanel"></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= SINGLE-CALL SCREEN ================= -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-singlecall">
    <div class="screen-head">
      <div class="tags">
        <span class="tag dot">Pattern: Single-Call (no retrieval, no tools, no chaining)</span>
        <span class="tag">Modes: Simple & Structured</span>
      </div>
      <h1>Single-Call Example App</h1>
      <p>The simplest agentic building block: one prompt goes in, one model response comes out — no retrieval, no external tools, no multi-step chaining. Toggle between a plain-text response and a schema-conforming structured response to see the same pattern rendered both ways.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px;">
      <h4>What is the single-call pattern?</h4>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0;">A single call sends one prompt to the shared generation service and returns one response, with nothing in between — no dataset lookup, no external tool, no follow-up call. It's the right choice for straightforward tasks like summarizing, classifying, or extracting information from a piece of text, where grounding in outside data or live information isn't required.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <h4>Choose or write a prompt</h4>
      <div class="chip-row" id="scPresetChips"></div>
      <label class="field-label" style="margin-top:0;">Prompt</label>
      <textarea id="scPromptInput" rows="3" placeholder="Write your own prompt, or pick a preset above (each labeled with its task)..."></textarea>

      <label class="field-label">Response mode</label>
      <div class="mode-toggle" id="scModeToggle">
        <button type="button" class="mode-btn active" data-mode="simple">Simple (plain text)</button>
        <button type="button" class="mode-btn" data-mode="structured">Structured (schema-conforming)</button>
      </div>

      <div class="console-actions">
        <button class="btn" id="scSubmit">Run single call</button>
      </div>
      <div class="field-hint" id="scValidationMsg" style="display:none;">Please enter a prompt or choose a preset above before submitting.</div>
    </div>

    <div class="result-panel" id="scResultPanel"></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= CHAINED-CALLS SCREEN ================= -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-chained">
    <div class="screen-head">
      <div class="tags">
        <span class="tag dot">Pattern: Chained Calls (exactly 2 sequential calls)</span>
        <span class="tag">Roles: Struggling Writer → Harsh Critic</span>
      </div>
      <h1>Chained-Calls Example App</h1>
      <p>Submit a short story idea. It's routed through two sequential model calls: a "struggling writer" persona drafts the story, then a "harsh critic" persona critiques that exact draft. Both the intermediate and final outputs stay visible, so the hand-off between steps is never hidden.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px;">
      <h4>What is the chained-calls pattern?</h4>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">A chained-calls workflow feeds the output of one model call into the input of the next, letting each step focus on a narrower job than a single call could handle alone. Here, Call 1 (the writer) produces a draft, and Call 2 (the critic) receives that draft and produces a critique of it — the second call's input is literally the first call's output.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0;">To conserve shared usage, this demo intentionally runs <strong>exactly two</strong> chained calls per submission. The pattern itself supports chains of any length — this is a minimal, legible illustration of it, not a limit of the pattern.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <h4>Write a story prompt</h4>
      <div class="chip-row" id="chainedChips"></div>
      <form class="qform" id="chainedForm">
        <input type="text" id="chainedInput" placeholder="e.g. a lonely lighthouse keeper who finds a message in a bottle" />
        <button class="btn" type="submit" id="chainedSubmit">Run chain (2 calls)</button>
      </form>
      <div class="steps" id="chainedSteps">
        <div class="step" data-step="1"><span class="num">Call 1</span><span class="label">Struggling Writer — drafts a short story</span></div>
        <div class="step" data-step="2"><span class="num">Call 2</span><span class="label">Harsh Critic — critiques that exact draft</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="result-panel" id="chainedResultPanel"></div>
  </section>

  <!-- ================= PLANNING-AGENT SCREEN ================= -->
  <section class="screen" id="screen-planning">
    <div class="screen-head">
      <div class="tags">
        <span class="tag dot">Pattern: Planning Agent (plan-first)</span>
        <span class="tag">Scenario: One-day trip planner</span>
        <span class="tag">Limits: 1 planner + 3 executor calls per run · 3 runs per session</span>
      </div>
      <h1>Planning-Agent Example App</h1>
      <p>Give the agent a city and your interests. A planner call decomposes that fuzzy goal into a small, visible plan of discrete steps — web research plus one final synthesis. The plan is shown first; nothing executes until you explicitly give the go-ahead. Then executor calls run the steps in sequence, each result appearing as it completes, ending in a one-day itinerary.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px;">
      <h4>What is the planning-agent pattern?</h4>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">A planning agent first calls a model to <strong>decompose a goal into a plan</strong> of discrete steps, then executes those steps one by one — here, research steps that use the shared web search tool, ending in exactly one synthesis step that composes the final itinerary. Because the plan is produced and displayed before execution, you can inspect exactly what the agent intends to do.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">This is the <strong>plan-first</strong> shape of the planning-agent tier: the whole plan is committed to before any observation comes back. The contrasting shape is <strong>interleaved reason–act–observe</strong>, where nothing is planned ahead — the agent thinks, takes one action, reads the observation, and only then decides its next step. See the <span class="xref-link" data-goto="screen-react">ReAct-Loop Example App</span> for that shape side by side with this one: same tier, opposite commitment point.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0;">To conserve shared usage, each run in this demo is limited to <strong>1 planner call plus up to 3 executor calls</strong>, and you get <strong>3 runs per session</strong>. Planning agents in general can use any number of steps — these limits are a quota-conservation choice, not a limit of the pattern.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <h4>Describe your trip day</h4>
      <div class="chip-row" id="planChips"></div>
      <form id="planForm">
        <label class="field-label" style="margin-top:0;">City</label>
        <input type="text" class="text-input" id="planCity" placeholder="e.g. Lisbon" />
        <label class="field-label">Interests</label>
        <input type="text" class="text-input" id="planInterests" placeholder="e.g. street food, modern art, walkable neighborhoods" />
        <div class="console-actions">
          <button class="btn" type="submit" id="planSubmit">Generate plan (1 planner call)</button>
          <span class="tag" id="planRunsTag"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="field-hint" id="planValidationMsg" style="display:none;">Please provide both a city and your interests before generating a plan.</div>
      </form>
    </div>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px;">
      <h4>What is the reason–act–observe loop?</h4>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">In an interleaved loop the agent never commits to a plan. It produces a short <strong>thought</strong>, takes one <strong>action</strong> (issue a search, or declare it can now answer), reads the <strong>observation</strong> that action returns, and then thinks again with that observation in hand. The second query is written only after the first result is read — which is exactly what makes multi-hop questions possible.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">This is deliberately the opposite commitment point from the <span class="xref-link" data-goto="screen-planning">Planning-Agent Example App</span>, which decomposes the goal into a full plan up front, shows it to you for approval, and only then executes. Same planning-agent tier, opposite shape: plan-first commits before any observation exists; ReAct commits one step at a time. It is also more than <em>a single decision about whether to search</em> — the loop makes that decision again on every cycle.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">Honest caveat: on the two more familiar presets the model may state an early hop straight from its own knowledge and spend its searches where observation is genuinely needed. That is a real behaviour of the pattern, not a bug — after each run the trace is annotated hop by hop so you can see which facts came from an observation and which were recalled. Presets 1–3 are curated so that at least one hop is time-variable or obscure enough to defeat memorised knowledge.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0;">To conserve shared usage this example carries the gallery's tightest limit: <strong>2 runs per session</strong>, and every cycle's search and model call is accounted against the showcase-wide daily allowance before it is issued. The loop itself can run as long as you like — the cycle budget here is a quota-conservation choice.</p>

      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">Subagents are independent workers. A coordinator decides who should work on what, writes each of them a brief, and — because neither subagent depends on the other's output — <strong>they can run at the same time</strong>. That's the fan-out. When both finish, a merge step reconciles their answers into one, which is the fan-in.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">To conserve shared usage, each run here uses a fixed budget of <strong>3 model calls</strong> (1 coordinator + 2 specialists, with the merge folded into the final call) and you get <strong>3 runs per session</strong>. The pattern itself supports any number of agents — these limits are a quota-conservation choice, not a property of the pattern.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0;">These specialists are <strong>workers under one coordinator's control</strong>, not peers negotiating with each other. For the contrasting case — independent parties with private information exchanging messages across a trust boundary — see the <strong>Multi-Agent Collaboration Example App</strong>.</p>

    <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:18px;">
      <h4>What is the multi-agent collaboration pattern?</h4>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">In collaboration, agents are <strong>peers</strong>, not workers. No agent owns the others' reasoning; each has its own goals, its own private information, and communicates only through explicit sender→recipient messages. Contrast this with the <strong>Orchestrated-Subagents</strong> example, where one coordinator writes the briefs, controls the workers, and sees everything they produce.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">The opacity here is <strong>enforced in code, not by instruction</strong>: each agent is only ever handed the messages addressed to it, so a seller literally has no channel through which to learn the rival's price — even if it asks. The message log below lets you verify that there is no seller-to-seller traffic at all.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0 0 10px;">Exchanges use the <strong>data model and interaction pattern of the A2A collaboration protocol</strong> — inspectable agent identity cards, peer task and message objects with an explicit sender and recipient, and work items attached to each message — but <strong>without its network transport</strong>. A real deployment would add agent discovery over the wire, authenticated endpoints per party, signed messages, and independent hosting for each organisation.</p>
      <p style="color:var(--text-dim); font-size:13.5px; margin:0;"><strong>Candidly:</strong> all three agents here ship under one owner, so the trust boundary is <em>staged for teaching</em> rather than genuinely cross-organisational. And for a purchase this simple, a peer negotiation between autonomous agents would be over-engineering in a real system — the pattern earns its keep when the parties really are separate and really do hold information the others must not see. Each run consumes a fixed budget of <strong>6 model calls</strong> (2 opening bids + 2 counter-offers + 2 final bids; the RFQ is composed without a model call, the award and reveal narration fold into the final call) and you get <strong>2 runs per session</strong>.     document.getElementById('tbody-'+sA.id).innerHTML = `<h6>Opening bid</h6><p class="bid-note" id="note-${sA.id}"></p>`;
    document.getElementById('tbody-'+sB.id).innerHTML = `<h6>Opening bid</h6><p class="bid-note" id="note-${sB.id}"></p>`;

    let openingDone = 0;
    function openingComplete(){
      openingDone++;
      if(openingDone === 2) startCounterOffers();
    }

    function runOpening(seller, data, delay){
      setTimeout(()=>{
        bump('generation', 1);
        pushLog('Multi-Agent Collaboration App', 'Text generation', `Opening bid from ${seller.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}`);
        const body = document.getElementById('tbody-'+seller.id);
        body.innerHTML = `<h6>Opening bid</h6>${bidTableHtml(scenario, data.opening, null)}<p class="bid-note" id="note-${seller.id}"></p>`;
        typeIntoPlain(document.getElementById('note-'+seller.id), data.openingNote, ()=>{
          setTrackStatus(seller.id, 'opening bid in', 'done');
          addMsg(seller.name.replace('Seller Agent ',''), 'Buyer Procura', 'Opening bid', data.openingNote, 'Bid');
          openingComplete();
        });
      }, delay);
    }
    runOpening(sA, dataA, 800);
    runOpening(sB, dataB, 1150);

    /* Stage 3 — buyer counter-offers */
    function startCounterOffers(){
      setRail(2, 2);
      const buyerWrap = document.getElementById('collabBuyer');
      buyerWrap.innerHTML = `
        <div class="buyer-track">
          <h6>Stage 3 · Buyer counter-offers — one targeted ask per seller</h6>
          <div class="stage-line" style="margin-bottom:0;"><span class="spinner"></span> Buyer agent is comparing two non-comparable bids and drafting a different ask for each…</div>
        </div>`;

      setTimeout(()=>{
        bump('generation', 2);
        pushLog('Multi-Agent Collaboration App', 'Text generation', 'Stage 3: buyer drafted two targeted counter-offers');

        const askA = scenario.id === 'laptops'
          ? `Your quantity and warranty are strong but your ${dataA.opening.delivery} delivery is the weakest term on the table against our stated priority of ${priority.label.toLowerCase()}. Improve price and warranty, or shorten delivery — one of the three.`
          : `Your full-coverage position is strong, but the lead time is the weakest term against our stated priority of ${priority.label.toLowerCase()}. Improve price and on-site staffing, or shorten lead time.`;
        const askB = scenario.id === 'laptops'
          ? `Your delivery and warranty lead the field, but ${dataB.opening.qty} does not meet our baseline requirement. Close the quantity gap and improve unit price, or we cannot award you the whole contract.`
          : `Your speed and staffing lead the field, but £${dataB.opening.price.replace('£','')} per cover is well above the rival position. Improve price, and shorten the lead time if you genuinely can.`;

        buyerWrap.innerHTML = `
          <div class="buyer-track">
            <h6>Stage 3 · Buyer counter-offers — one targeted ask per seller</h6>
            <p class="bid-note"><span class="party-pill">→ ${sA.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}</span> ${askA}</p>
            <p class="bid-note"><span class="party-pill">→ ${sB.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}</span> ${askB}</p>
            <p class="bid-note"><span class="source-label">Each counter-offer names only the recipient's own terms. The buyer never quotes one seller's numbers to the other — the asks are phrased from the buyer's own requirement, not from the rival's bid.</span></p>
          </div>`;
        addMsg('Buyer Procura', sA.name.replace('Seller Agent ',''), 'Counter-offer', askA, 'CounterOffer');
        addMsg('Buyer Procura', sB.name.replace('Seller Agent ',''), 'Counter-offer', askB, 'CounterOffer');
        startFinalBids();
      }, 900);
    }

    /* Stage 4 — concurrent best-and-final bids */
    function startFinalBids(){
      setRail(3, 3);
      setTrackStatus(sA.id, 'best & final', 'running');
      setTrackStatus(sB.id, 'best & final', 'running');
      document.getElementById('tbody-'+sA.id).insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div id="final-${sA.id}" style="margin-top:12px;"><h6>Best & final bid</h6><div class="stage-line" style="margin-bottom:0;"><span class="spinner"></span> revising…</div></div>`);
      document.getElementById('tbody-'+sB.id).insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<div id="final-${sB.id}" style="margin-top:12px;"><h6>Best & final bid</h6><div class="stage-line" style="margin-bottom:0;"><span class="spinner"></span> revising…</div></div>`);

      let finalDone = 0;
      function finalComplete(){
        finalDone++;
        if(finalDone === 2) makeAward();
      }
      function runFinal(seller, data, delay){
        setTimeout(()=>{
          bump('generation', 1);
          pushLog('Multi-Agent Collaboration App', 'Text generation', `Best-and-final bid from ${seller.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}`);
          const wrap = document.getElementById('final-'+seller.id);
          wrap.innerHTML = `<h6>Best & final bid</h6>${bidTableHtml(scenario, data.final, data.conceded)}<p class="bid-note" id="fnote-${seller.id}"></p>`;
          typeIntoPlain(document.getElementById('fnote-'+seller.id), data.finalNote, ()=>{
            setTrackStatus(seller.id, 'final bid in', 'done');
            addMsg(seller.name.replace('Seller Agent ',''), 'Buyer Procura', 'Best & final', data.finalNote, 'Bid');
            finalComplete();
          });
        }, delay);
      }
      runFinal(sA, dataA, 800);
      runFinal(sB, dataB, 1200);
    }

    /* Stage 5 — award, Stage 6 — reveal */
    function makeAward(){
      setRail(4, 4);
      const awardWrap = document.getElementById('collabAward');
      awardWrap.innerHTML = `<div class="stage-line" style="margin-top:16px;"><span class="spinner"></span> Buyer agent is weighing both best-and-final bids against your stated priorities…</div>`;

      setTimeout(()=>{
        const winner = priority.winner === sA.id ? sA : sB;
        const loser = winner.id === sA.id ? sB : sA;
        const wData = scenario.sellers[winner.id];
        const lData = scenario.sellers[loser.id];

        const rationale = scenario.id === 'laptops'
          ? (priority.id === 'price'
            ? `You weighted <strong>price first, full quantity required</strong>. ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} lands at ${wData.final.price} for the complete ${wData.final.qty}, against ${lData.final.price} for only ${lData.final.qty} from ${loser.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}. The rival's ${lData.final.delivery} delivery is genuinely better, but speed was explicitly secondary and the quantity shortfall breaks your baseline requirement outright. Award goes to ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}.`
            : `You weighted <strong>speed first, partial tranche acceptable</strong>. ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} delivers in ${wData.final.delivery} against ${lData.final.delivery} — nearly three weeks earlier — and its ${wData.final.warranty} warranty leads too. It costs ${wData.final.price} versus ${lData.final.price}, and it covers only ${wData.final.qty}, but you marked a partial first tranche acceptable and price secondary. Award goes to ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}.`)
          : (priority.id === 'price'
            ? `You weighted <strong>price first, full coverage required</strong>. ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} lands at ${wData.final.price} per cover for all ${wData.final.qty} with ${wData.final.warranty}, against ${lData.final.price} from ${loser.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}. The rival's ${lData.final.delivery} lead time and ${lData.final.warranty} are stronger, but both were secondary under your weighting. Award goes to ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}.`
            : `You weighted <strong>speed first</strong>. ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} pulled its lead time to ${lData ? wData.final.delivery : ''} against ${lData.final.delivery} and fields ${wData.final.warranty}. It costs ${wData.final.price} versus ${lData.final.price} per cover, which is real money, but price was explicitly secondary here. Award goes to ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}.`);

        const sensitivity = scenario.id === 'laptops'
          ? (priority.id === 'price'
            ? `Under <strong>Speed first</strong> instead, ${loser.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} would very likely have won: its ${lData.final.delivery} delivery beats ${wData.final.delivery} by around three weeks, and a partial tranche would stop being disqualifying. The dimension that flips the result is <strong>delivery lead time versus quantity completeness</strong> — nothing about the bids themselves changes, only which axis you weight.`
            : `Under <strong>Price first</strong> instead, ${loser.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} would very likely have won: ${lData.final.price} for the complete ${lData.final.qty} beats ${wData.final.price} for ${wData.final.qty}. The dimension that flips the result is <strong>unit price combined with quantity completeness</strong>.`)
          : (priority.id === 'price'
            ? `Under <strong>Speed first</strong> instead, ${loser.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} would very likely have won on its ${lData.final.delivery} lead time and ${lData.final.warranty}. The flipping dimension is <strong>lead time</strong>.`
            : `Under <strong>Price first</strong> instead, ${loser.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} would very likely have won at ${lData.final.price} per cover. The flipping dimension is <strong>price per cover</strong>.`);

        bump('generation', 0);
        pushLog('Multi-Agent Collaboration App', 'Text generation', `Stage 5: award to ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')} (rationale + reveal folded into final call)`);

        awardWrap.innerHTML = `
          <div class="answer-card" style="margin-top:16px;">
            <div class="routing-line">↳ round complete: 1 buyer + 2 rival sellers · 6 model calls used · 1 negotiation round</div>
            <div class="answer-meta">
              <span class="tag dot">Award: ${winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ','')}</span>
              <span class="tag">Your priorities: ${priority.label}</span>
              <span class="confidence high">Run complete — declared 6-call budget not exceeded</span>
            </div>
            <div class="answer-text">${rationale}</div>
            <div class="merge-note">
              <h6>Priority sensitivity — what the other weighting would have done</h6>
              <ul><li>${sensitivity}</li></ul>
            </div>
            <div class="console-actions">
              <span class="source-label">Call budget used: 2 opening bids + 2 counter-offers + 2 best-and-final bids = 6. The RFQ was composed without a model call; the award rationale, sensitivity note and reveal narration folded into the final call.</span>
            </div>
          </div>`;
        addMsg('Buyer Procura', winner.name.replace('Seller Agent ',''), 'Award', 'Contract awarded, rationale referencing the stated priorities.', 'Award');
        addMsg('Buyer Procura', loser.name.replace('Seller Agent ',''), 'Award', 'Not awarded this round, with the deciding dimension named.', 'Award');

        setRail(5, 5);
        renderReveal(scenario, winner, loser);
        collabStartBtn.disabled = collabRuns.used >= collabRuns.cap;
        if(collabRuns.used >= collabRuns.cap){
          collabScenarioSelect.disabled = true;
          collabPriorityToggle.querySelectorAll('.mode-btn').forEach(b=>b.disabled = true);
        }
      }, 950);
    }

    function renderReveal(scenario, winner, loser){
      const revealWrap = document.getElementById('collabReveal');
      const parties = [
        { name: buyerAgent.name, color: buyerAgent.color, headline:'The buyer held one number back from both sellers throughout.', axes:[scenario.buyerConstraint], flag:'' },
        { name: sellerAgents[0].name, color: sellerAgents[0].color, headline: sellerAgents[0].id === winner.id ? 'Won the award — here is what it was actually protecting.' : 'Did not win — here is what it could and could not move.', axes: scenario.sellers[sellerAgents[0].id].constraints, flag: sellerAgents[0].id === winner.id ? 'awarded' : '' },
        { name: sellerAgents[1].name, color: sellerAgents[1].color, headline: sellerAgents[1].id === winner.id ? 'Won the award — here is what it was actually protecting.' : 'Did not win — here is what it could and could not move.', axes: scenario.sellers[sellerAgents[1].id].constraints, flag: sellerAgents[1].id === winner.id ? 'awarded' : '' }
      ];
      revealWrap.innerHTML = `
        <div class="warning-banner" style="background:rgba(78,161,255,.08); border-color:rgba(78,161,255,.3); color:var(--accent2);">🔓 Round complete — private positions unsealed. Until this moment none of this was visible to the visitor, and none of it was ever visible to the rival seller.</div>
        ${parties.map(p=>`
          <div class="reveal-party">
            <div class="rp-head"><span class="spec-dot" style="background:${p.color};"></span>${p.name}${p.flag ? `<span class="winner-flag" style="margin-left:auto;">${p.flag}</span>` : ''}</div>
            <p class="rp-headline">${p.headline}</p>
            ${p.axes.map(a=>`
              <div class="reveal-axis">
                <span class="ax-name">${a.axis}</span>
                <span><strong style="color:var(--text);">${a.hidden}.</strong> ${a.why}</span>
              </div>`).join('')}
          </div>`).join('')}
        <p class="source-label" style="display:block; margin-top:6px;">Cross-check the message log above: none of these values appear in any message either seller received. The opacity was enforced by which messages each agent was handed, not by asking it to keep a secret.</p>`;
    }
  }

  /* ================= EMBEDDINGS EXAMPLE APP ================= */
  const EMBED_VIEW_W = 560, EMBED_VIEW_H = 380;

  const embeddingCategories = [
    { name:'Animals', colorVar:'--accent2', center:{x:140,y:100}, words:['cat','dog','elephant','dolphin','eagle','lion'] },
    { name:'Emotions', colorVar:'--danger', center:{x:420,y:100}, words:['joy','sadness','anger','fear','excitement','calm'] },
    { name:'Technology', colorVar:'--accent1', center:{x:140,y:280}, words:['computer','algorithm','network','robot','database','software'] },
    { name:'Food', colorVar:'--warn', center:{x:420,y:280}, words:['pizza','sushi','bread','coffee','apple','chocolate'] }
  ];

  function hashStr(str){
    let h = 0;
    for(let i=0;i<str.length;i++){ h = (h*31 + str.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0; }
    return h;
  }
  function jitter(seed, range){
    const h = hashStr(seed);
    return (h % (range*2+1)) - range;
  }
  function clamp(v, min, max){ return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }

  const presetPoints = [];
  embeddingCategories.forEach(cat=>{
    cat.words.forEach(w=>{
      const x = clamp(cat.center.x + jitter(w+'_x', 55), 25, EMBED_VIEW_W-25);
      const y = clamp(cat.center.y + jitter(w+'_y', 55), 25, EMBED_VIEW_H-25);
      presetPoints.push({ text:w, category:cat.name, colorVar:cat.colorVar, x, y });
    });
  });

  let customPoints = [];

  function matchCategory(text){
    const lower = text.toLowerCase();
    const tokens = lower.replace(/[^a-z0-9\s]/g,'').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
    let best = null, bestScore = 0;
    embeddingCategories.forEach(cat=>{
      let score = 0;
      cat.words.forEach(w=>{
        if(lower.includes(w)) score += 2;
        tokens.forEach(t=>{ if(t && (w.includes(t) || t.includes(w))) score += 1; });
      });
      if(score > bestScore){ bestScore = score; best = cat; }
    });
    return { category: best, score: bestScore };
  }

  function nearestNeighbors(x, y, n){
    return presetPoints
      .map(p => ({ ...p, dist: Math.hypot(p.x - x, p.y - y) }))
      .sort((a,b)=> a.dist - b.dist)
      .slice(0, n);
  }

  function addCustomText(text){
    const match = matchCategory(text);
    let cx, cy, catName;
    if(match.category && match.score > 0){
      cx = clamp(match.category.center.x + jitter(text+'_cx', 60), 25, EMBED_VIEW_W-25);
      cy = clamp(match.category.center.y + jitter(text+'_cy', 60), 25, EMBED_VIEW_H-25);
      catName = match.category.name;
    } else {
      cx = clamp(EMBED_VIEW_W/2 + jitter(text+'_cx', 90), 25, EMBED_VIEW_W-25);
      cy = clamp(EMBED_VIEW_H/2 + jitter(text+'_cy', 90), 25, EMBED_VIEW_H-25);
      catName = null;
    }
    const neighbors = nearestNeighbors(cx, cy, 3);
    const point = { text, x:cx, y:cy, category:catName, neighbors };
    customPoints.push(point);
    return point;
  }

  function renderEmbedPlot(){
    const wrap = document.getElementById('embedPlotWrap');
    const presetMarkers = presetPoints.map(p => `
      <circle cx="${p.x}" cy="${p.y}" r="6" style="fill:var(${p.colorVar}); opacity:0.85;">
        <title>${p.text} — ${p.category}</title>
      </circle>
      <text x="${p.x+9}" y="${p.y+3}" class="embed-point-label">${p.text}</text>
    `).join('');
    const customMarkers = customPoints.map(p => `
      <rect x="${p.x-6}" y="${p.y-6}" width="12" height="12" transform="rotate(45 ${p.x} ${p.y})" style="fill:url(#embedGrad); stroke:#fff; stroke-width:1;">
        <title>${p.text} (your text)</title>
      </rect>
      <text x="${p.x+11}" y="${p.y+3}" class="embed-point-label" style="fill:var(--text); font-weight:600;">${p.text}</text>
    `).join('');
    wrap.innerHTML = `
      <svg viewBox="0 0 ${EMBED_VIEW_W} ${EMBED_VIEW_H}" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <defs>
          <linearGradient id="embedGrad" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
            <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#7c5cff"/>
            <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#4ea1ff"/>
          </linearGradient>
        </defs>
        ${presetMarkers}
        ${customMarkers}
      </svg>
    `;
  }
  renderEmbedPlot();

  const embedSuggestions = ['sushi rolls', 'quantum computer', 'the lion king', 'so much joy today', 'philosophy'];
  const embedChipsEl = document.getElementById('embedChips');
  embedSuggestions.forEach(q=>{
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'chip';
    c.textContent = q;
    c.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ document.getElementById('embedInput').value = q; });
    embedChipsEl.appendChild(c);
  });

  const embedForm = document.getElementById('embedForm');
  const embedPanel = document.getElementById('embedResultPanel');

  embedForm.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const text = document.getElementById('embedInput').value.trim();
    if(!text) return;
    const submitBtn = document.getElementById('embedSubmit');
    submitBtn.disabled = true;

    if(isExhausted('representation')){
      embedPanel.innerHTML = `
        <div class="answer-card err">
          <div class="answer-meta"><span class="tag" style="border-color:var(--danger); color:var(--danger);">Service unavailable</span></div>
          <p style="margin:0;">The shared text representation service has hit its free-tier usage limit for today. Custom text cannot be embedded right now — try again later, or reset the limit from the Framework Console.</p>
        </div>`;
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      return;
    }

    embedPanel.innerHTML = `<div class="stage-line"><span class="spinner"></span> Embedding text using the shared embedding model…</div>`;

    setTimeout(()=>{
      const point = addCustomText(text);
      renderEmbedPlot();

      const neighborsHtml = point.neighbors.map(n => `
        <div class="passage">
          <div class="passage-top">
            <strong>${n.text}</strong>
            <span class="score-badge">${n.category}</span>
          </div>
          <p>Distance in projected space: ${n.dist.toFixed(1)}</p>
        </div>
      `).join('');

      embedPanel.innerHTML = `
        <div class="answer-card ${point.category ? '' : 'warn'}">
          <div class="answer-meta">
            <span class="tag dot">Custom text: “${text}”</span>
            <span class="confidence ${point.category ? 'high' : 'low'}">${point.category ? 'Placed near ' + point.category + ' cluster' : 'No strong category match — placed centrally'}</span>
          </div>
          ${point.category ? '' : `<div class="warning-banner">⚠ This text doesn't closely match any of the four curated categories, so it was placed near the center of the plot rather than inside a cluster.</div>`}
          <div class="answer-text">Your text was converted into an embedding vector by the shared embedding model, then projected into the same fixed 2D space used for the preset examples above — the presets don't move, so this addition is directly comparable.</div>
          <div class="passages-block">
            <h5>Nearest neighbors</h5>
            ${neighborsHtml}
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
      submitBtn.disabled = false;
      bump('representation', 1);
      pushLog('Embeddings Example App', 'Text representation', `Embedded custom text: “${text.slice(0,40)}${text.length>40?'…':''}”`);
      document.getElementById('embedInput').value = '';
    }, 600);
  });

  /* ================= FRAMEWORK SERVICES CONSOLE ================= */
  const reqType = document.getElementById('reqType');
  const reqPayload = document.getElementById('reqPayload');
  const sendReqBtn = document.getElementById('sendReq');
  const responseBox = document.getElementById('responseBox');
  const simulateLimitBtn = document.getElementById('simulateLimit');

  const placeholders = {
    generation: 'Summarize how BWS4 uses Spec4 to teach agentic patterns.',
    representation: 'Voyager 1 launched in 1977 and entered interstellar space in 2012.',
    storage: 'key: "visitor_last_question" value: "What is the James Webb Space Telescope?"'
  };
  reqType.addEventListener('change', ()=>{
    reqPayload.placeholder = placeholders[reqType.value];
  });

  const storedRecords = [
    { key:'visitor_last_question', value:'What did the Apollo 11 mission accomplish?', writtenBy:'RAG Example App' }
  ];

  sendReqBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const type = reqType.value;
    const payload = reqPayload.value.trim() || placeholders[type];
    const capKey = type === 'generation' ? 'generation' : type === 'representation' ? 'representation' : 'storage';

    if(isExhausted(capKey)){
      responseBox.classList.add('err');
      responseBox.textContent = `⚠ Request rejected: "${usage[capKey].label}" has reached its free-tier limit (${usage[capKey].used}/${usage[capKey].cap}). This is the same clear-failure behavior every example app sees when a shared capability is exhausted.`;
      return;
    }
    responseBox.classList.remove('err');
    responseBox.textContent = 'Sending request to shared framework services…';

    setTimeout(()=>{
      let out;
      if(type === 'generation'){
        out = `[LanguageGenerationRequest → response]\nprompt: "${payload}"\n\n→ "BWS4 pairs a small set of teaching-oriented example apps — RAG, tool use, single-call, chained calls, planning agent, ReAct loop, orchestrated subagents, multi-agent collaboration, embeddings, and more — with shared services for generation, representation, and storage, all implemented using Spec4 itself so the framework's own build doubles as the demonstration."`;
      } else if(type === 'representation'){
        const fakeVec = Array.from({length:6}, ()=> (Math.random()*2-1).toFixed(3)).join(', ');
        out = `[TextRepresentation → response]\nsourceText: "${payload}"\n\nvectorPreview: [${fakeVec}, ...]\ndimensions: 768`;
      } else {
        storedRecords.push({ key:`console_test_${storedRecords.length+1}`, value: payload, writtenBy:'Framework Console' });
        const latest = storedRecords.slice(-3).map(r=>`  { key: "${r.key}", value: "${r.value.slice(0,42)}${r.value.length>42?'…':''}", writtenBy: "${r.writtenBy}" }`).join('\n');
        out = `[StoredRecord → write + retrieve]\nwritten: { key: "console_test_${storedRecords.length}", value: "${payload.slice(0,42)}${payload.length>42?'…':''}" }\n\nrecent records available to all apps:\n${latest}`;
      }
      responseBox.textContent = out;
      bump(capKey, type === 'storage' ? 1 : 2);
      pushLog('Framework Console', usage[capKey].label, `Manual test request (${type})`);
    }, 500);
  });

  simulateLimitBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const capKey = reqType.value === 'generation' ? 'generation' : reqType.value === 'representation' ? 'representation' : 'storage';
    usage[capKey].used = usage[capKey].cap;
    renderUsage();
    responseBox.classList.add('err');
    responseBox.textContent = `⚠ Simulated: "${usage[capKey].label}" usage limit has been forced to ${usage[capKey].cap}/${usage[capKey].cap}. Send a request now to see the clear-failure message every app would receive.`;
  });

})();
